standard_deviation: sample, ddof=1, across ten support seeds
candidate_range_source: official configs/RN50/configs_proker/fgvc.yaml; reduced fixed grid within the published range
selection_tie_break: highest Macro-F1, then lowest beta, then lowest lambda; no Test-dependent decisions

1shot.source: official configs/RN50/configs_proker/hyperparameters.json key 1; ImageNet RN50 parameters transferred without WM tuning

5shot_10shot.groups: unique content hashes of original support images; every augmented view remains in its image's training group
5shot_10shot.selection_metric: Macro-F1 from concatenated out-of-fold predictions, separately per task

fgvc_selection.support_source: unchanged Training support manifests, seeds 0 through 9
fgvc_selection.selection_metric: unweighted mean Validation Macro-F1 across ten support seeds, separately for each shot
fgvc_selection.test_policy: freeze all three parameter pairs before evaluating any ProKeR Test task

support_augmentation.combination: concatenate normalized views as kernel support rows, as in official main.py; do not average views
support_augmentation.unique_labeled_image_budget: C times K; augmented views do not add labels

text_prior: existing generic baseline prompt per class; normalized frozen CLIP text embedding
solution: A = solve(K_SS / lambda + I, one_hot_Y - S @ T.T)
solver: exact dense Cholesky of K_SS + lambda I, RHS multiplied by lambda; float32; no low-rank approximation
history_note: These datasets have existing Test results. This new baseline protocol freezes new selection rules before new formal evaluation; it does not restore historical Test independence or constitute prospective preregistration.
comparison_note: Same-protocol port, not official numerical reproduction. Original grids use 200 pairs and Accuracy, original shot/seed grids differ. Current candidate budget is 16; FGVC uses full existing Validation and Macro-F1; WM uses support-only CV or external fixed parameters. Other baselines have different tuning and optimization budgets.
